query.text: 购物助手，请陪我一起选购商品，在我询问商品新鲜度或挑选建议时给予解答。
query.text_en: Shopping assistant, please shop with me and answer my questions when I ask about product freshness or need selection advice.

annotation.text_zh: 这棵青菜叶片挺绿的，看着还很新鲜。
annotation.text_en: These greens look really fresh and vibrant.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
